radius.$description: Corner radii: shadcn/ui's ramp, derived from its base --radius of 0.625rem (10px) as sm = base-4, md = base-2, lg = base, xl = base+4. One four-step ramp keeps a control nested in a row nested in a card looking like one system.

r-xs.$description: Smallest rounding — inline marks, tiny swatches.

r-chip.$description: Alias kept because chips are referred to by name across the UI; there is no separate chip radius any more.

r-ctl.$description: shadcn `--radius-md`, the default on Button and Input.

r-input.$description: Alias: fields share the control radius.

r-row.$description: shadcn `--radius-lg`, and the base radius. History rows and list items.

r-card.$description: shadcn `--radius-xl`, the default on Card and Dialog.

r-window.$description: The frameless window's own corner, matched to the card radius so the outermost surface is not a fifth value.

r-pill.$description: Fully rounded — pills, dots, the switch track.
